label: TEMPLATE / demo
topic: Lesson 27: Work Rate (工作效率／工程問題)
formulas: Work done ÷ Time = Rate (工作效率)
Work rate = the amount done in one unit of time (單位時間內完成的工作量)

questions.title: Question 1 · Find the rate
questions.q: Auntie Zhang made 14 buns in 2 hours. Auntie Li made 18 buns in 3 hours. How many buns does each make per hour? Who works faster?
questions.answer: Zhang 7 buns/h; Li 6 buns/h; Auntie Zhang is faster
questions.mistakes: Comparing totals (18 > 14) instead of dividing by time; dividing time by work.

questions.title: Question 2 · Find the time
questions.q: Ming reads 8 pages per hour. How many hours does he need to read a 48-page storybook?

questions.title: Question 3 · Find the work done
questions.q: Hua sews 12 shirts per hour. She sews for 3 hours. How many shirts does she sew altogether?

questions.title: Question 4 · Compare rates
questions.q: Big sister takes 6 hours to finish a job alone. Little sister takes 4 hours to finish the same job alone. Who has the higher work rate? Explain why.
questions.answer: Little sister (1/4 job per hour > 1/6 job per hour)
steps: 1/4 > 1/6 — same job in less time means higher rate
questions.mistakes: Thinking more hours means more work, so choosing big sister.

questions.title: Question 5 · Find the time
questions.q: A machine makes 120 parts per hour. How many hours does it need to make 960 parts?

questions.title: Question 6
questions.q: Mum cleans 8 windows per hour and Dad cleans 12 windows per hour. The house has 40 windows. If they clean together, how many hours will it take?
questions.mistakes: Using only one person's rate (40 ÷ 8), or subtracting the rates.
